name: graea
description: Give an LLM eyes on a Telegram bot: MTProto + Telegram Web screenshots + vision reader + DuckDB memory.

human_prereqs.notes: api_id/api_hash from https://my.telegram.org (API development tools) for a SPARE Telegram account, never the human's personal one. `phone` is that spare account's number, needed only for the phone-code handshake. If the human already has a GRAEA_SESSION_STRING from a previous login (see session_export below), phone/the phone-code step can be skipped entirely.

install_cmd: git clone https://github.com/estejosh/graea && cd graea && bash install.sh
install_cmd_no_container: git clone https://github.com/estejosh/graea && cd graea && bash install.sh --no-container

install_notes.why_background: an unattended agent must run the first build in the background and tail the log, because a killed build loses the in-flight layer and has to restart
install_notes.recommended_cmd: nohup bash install.sh > install.log 2>&1 & tail -f install.log
install_notes.rootless_podman: container uid 1000 maps through /etc/subuid to an unrelated host uid, so a host-owned ./data is not writable from inside the container without --userns=keep-id (already in every podman command below). install.sh also runs a one-time write-test and falls back to `chmod -R a+rwX ./data`, printing 'GRAEA_INSTALL: data dir writable: yes|repaired|NO'.

container.note: Replace /ABSOLUTE/PATH/TO/graea with the real clone path: MCP clients do not run from the repo directory, and podman bind mounts need an absolute path. --userns=keep-id keeps the bind-mounted ./data writable under rootless podman (see install_notes.rootless_podman). Vision endpoint on the host (e.g. Ollama) is http://host.containers.internal:11434/v1 from inside the container, not localhost.

mtproto.watch_stdout_for: GRAEA_LOGIN: waiting for code, write it to <path>
mtproto.watch_stdout_for_note: the prefix stays stable; inside the container this line prints BOTH paths ('... write it to /data/login-code.txt (container) = ./data/login-code.txt on the host') — the first path right after the prefix is always the one to parse.
mtproto.human_action: Telegram sends the spare account a login code by SMS/app; ask the human for it ONCE.
mtproto.respond_by: write the code to <path> named in the watched line (e.g. `echo 123456 > data/login-code.txt`), or set env GRAEA_LOGIN_CODE before running instead of writing a file
mtproto.error_line_note: printed (once, no traceback) for a rejected phone/code/2FA/api_id, or a Telegram rate limit; exit code 1. Fix per the hint and re-run.
mtproto.skip_if: GRAEA_SESSION_STRING is already set in .env (see session_export)

web.watch_stdout_for_note: inside the container this line also prints both the container path and the host-side ./data equivalent, same convention as the mtproto login above.
web.human_action: scan the QR image at <path> (e.g. data/login-qr.png) with the Telegram app on the spare account: Settings > Devices > Link Desktop Device.
web.respond_by: send the human the PNG at <path>; the QR is re-screenshotted to the same path roughly every 20s until scanned

session_export.prints: a Telethon StringSession on stdout, after `graea login` has been run once anywhere
session_export.use: set GRAEA_SESSION_STRING to this value in .env / any container's env to skip the phone-code handshake there entirely

status.exit_2: not connected/authorized yet, OR the connect attempt timed out (GRAEA_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_S, default 20s — first connect can be slow, just re-run) — check the `hint` field in the JSON output either way

doctor.exit_1: see the `problems` array in the JSON output
doctor.config_object: {api_id: set|missing, api_hash: set|missing|suspicious, phone: set|missing, session_string: set|missing, bot: <value>|placeholder|missing} — never echoes the actual api_hash/phone values
doctor.eacces_hint: if the data dir isn't writable, the problem text names the exact fix: run the container with --userns=keep-id, or on the host `chmod -R a+rwX ./data`

env.BUGS: comma list of planted bugs, empty = correct behavior

troubleshooting.rootless podman data dir permission deni: doctor prints 'data dir not writable (/data): Permission denied'. Container uid maps through /etc/subuid to a host uid that doesn't own your host ./data. Run the container with --userns=keep-id (already used throughout this file), or on the host: chmod -R a+rwX ./data.
troubleshooting.unauthorized session: GRAEA_SESSION points at a file/StringSession that was never logged in, or was logged in with different api_id/api_hash. Re-run the mtproto login protocol.
troubleshooting.web not logged in: `graea status --json` shows web_logged_in:false. Run the web login protocol (login-web shows the QR; it prints `already` only when a visible chat list is present and no auth page is showing). GRAEA_WEB_PROFILE must be a persistent, writable directory (bind-mounted, not ephemeral).
troubleshooting.vision unreachable: `graea doctor`'s vision_reachable is false. Point GRAEA_VISION_BASE_URL at a running OpenAI-compatible endpoint (e.g. Ollama), or set GRAEA_VISION_PROVIDER=ocr or =none. From inside the container, the host's Ollama is http://host.containers.internal:11434/v1 (localhost is the container itself).
troubleshooting.empty screenshots: Telegram Web's DOM changed. Run `graea web-probe` and attach data/web-probe.json + web-probe.png to the report. Hot-fix without code: GRAEA_SELECTORS_FILE=/path/sel.json with {"message_bubble": ["<css>"], ...}; entries are tried before the built-in SELECTORS in graea/visual/web.py.
troubleshooting.vision pending: vision.error says pending: you are the reader. Look at the returned screenshot image and call graea_submit_reading. Only switch GRAEA_VISION_PROVIDER to an engine if the driving LLM cannot see images.
a Telegram-side rejection (bad phone format, wrong/expired code, missing 2FA password, bad api_id/api_hash, rate limit) was caught and printed as one line with a hint — never a traceback. Fix per the hint (e.g. correct GRAEA_PHONE, set GRAEA_2FA_PASSWORD, wait out a FloodWaitError) and re-run login.
troubleshooting.status --json hint mentions connect time: the first MTProto connect can take longer than GRAEA_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_S (default 20s). Just re-run status; it isn't a credentials problem by itself.

vision.meaning: the LLM driving Graea reads each step's screenshot image itself and reports back via the graea_submit_reading MCP tool (or POST /reading); no second model needed. Alternatives: openai_compatible (Ollama/vLLM/LM Studio/OpenRouter/OpenAI), anthropic, ocr, none.

check_cmd.note: cheap (24h on-disk cache) and safe to run at the start of every session; also folded automatically into `graea_status`/`graea_status` MCP tool output and into a stderr banner on every non-mcp/serve CLI command.

container.note: or run `graea update` inside the container image itself (it shells out to podman on the host, so prefer running the pull directly on the host as shown here).

update.note: agents should run the check_cmd (or graea_update_check) once at the start of a session, and run update_cmd only when a human tells them to update. Container users always get updates via `podman pull ghcr.io/estejosh/graea:latest`.
